description: Source file implementing Windows-specific audio sink using XAudio2 API, managing audio playback, buffer submission, and error handling within the starboard shared namespace.

classes.name: XAudioAudioSink
classes.description: Represents an XAudio2-based audio sink, managing buffer submission, playback rate, volume, and callback control.

classes.name: XAudioAudioSinkType
classes.description: Factory and manager class for creating, destroying, and handling Windows XAudio2 audio sinks, including device restart and callback management.

methods.name: CHECK_HRESULT_OK
methods.description: Checks HRESULT for success, logs error if failed.

methods.name: SampleTypeToFormatTag
methods.description: Converts media sample type to WAVE format tag.

methods.name: SampleTypeToBitsPerSample
methods.description: Converts media sample type to bits per sample.

methods.name: XAudioCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes an IXAudio2 instance with debug configuration.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an XAudio2 source voice and associated audio sink.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a given audio sink, unregistering callbacks and scheduling deletion.

methods.name: RestartAudioDevice
methods.description: Reinitializes the audio device, recreates voices, and manages restart process.

methods.name: TryAcquireSinkVoices
methods.description: Attempts to create source voices for all sinks needing restart, scheduling retries on failure.

methods.name: OnProcessingPassStart
methods.description: Callback invoked periodically (~10ms) to process audio sinks during XAudio2 processing pass.
